changes.name: Removed 'rate' property from rate-limit response
changes.description: The `rate` property was removed from the JSON body of the rate-limit response. Rate limit information is now provided via `resources.core.remaining` and `resources.core.reset` in the JSON body. GitHub also recommends `x-ratelimit-*` response headers for real-time tracking, treating them as authoritative when they disagree with the endpoint response.
changes.old_behavior: Code reading `rate_limit_json['rate']['remaining']` or `rate.remaining` from the response body
changes.migration: Update code to read `resources.core.remaining` and `resources.core.reset` from the JSON response body instead of `rate.remaining` and `rate.reset`.
changes.verified_impact: Repositories that parse the rate-limit response JSON for `rate.remaining` will receive a complete rate limit object without the `rate` key, potentially causing KeyError or incorrect limit calculations.
